name: 153. Resumable files, computer use and response field path pins (files computer use and response field pins)
description: Held rows resolved with evidence. Gemini Files native lifecycle (153.1a-d share h153UploadUrl/h153FileId and must run in order; the resumable initiation and finalize bodies, and DELETE, are carved out of the generic shape check in __skipShape). Passthrough computer_use forwards the CLIENT beta header (no injection exists on the passthrough path, so the row is re-scoped to forwarding plus credential stripping). Cross-model computer use goes through /v1/responses computer_use_preview, because /v1/chat tools only support function and custom. Multi-value and unknown anthropic-beta follow the documented 400 behaviour. Bedrock additionalModelResponseFieldPaths follows the documented /stop_sequence example and the documented 400 for a malformed pointer. 153.8 embeds a 1s wav generated at build time (about 10KB) and is [PREVIEW] for gpt-4o-audio-preview access.

exec: pm.test('initiation returns an upload url carrying an upload_id', function () { pm.expect(url, 'no X-Goog-Upload-URL header; body: ' + pm.response.text()).to.be.a('string').and.include('upload_id='); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Goog-Upload-Status')).to.equal('active'); });

item.name: 153.1b gemini files upload step 2 finalizes and returns the file (gemini files lifecycle)

exec: pm.test('finalize returns a files/ resource name and uri', function () { pm.expect(f.name, pm.response.text()).to.match(/^files\/.+/); pm.expect(f.uri, pm.response.text()).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
